name: Appleblossom Academy
source:
Welcome to Appleblossom Academy! It's your first day of school in a small town and you're already introduced to some new friends. Find a girl that's best for you and get to know her! Choose who you hang out with carefully!

[From [url=https://commandercookie.itch.io/appleblossom-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到苹果花学院！这是你在小镇上学的第一天，你已经认识了一些新朋友。找到一个最适合你的女孩并了解她！仔细选择和你一起出去玩的人！

[来自[url=https://commandercookie.itch.io/appleblossom-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
